items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: I think Tipitina's one of them.

ctx.x: A couple of long hair songs that I'm, my name is on a song as writer. And, and, and, and he's, I think Tipitina's one of them. Okay. But it's a couple of them. I don't even remember right now. Anyway, uh, he sent me some letters asking me to, to, to, to, like, meet with him to resolve the thing. In other words, come in here and, and, and, and, and kneel and, and confess your sins and, and, and we'll pat you on the head and say, go and sin no more. You know. And, uh, and, and, uh.
